name: owid
description: Skills for working with Our World in Data: search published charts, fetch chart data and metadata via the web API, join OWID data with external sources (e.g. per-capita metrics), and access the full data catalog with the owid-catalog Python library.

interface.shortDescription: Find, fetch and analyse Our World in Data's charts and data.
interface.longDescription: Search Our World in Data's published charts across population, energy, climate, poverty, health, education and more; fetch the data and metadata behind any chart; join it with other sources; and load the full catalog as pandas DataFrames that carry their own units, sources and citations. Read-only, and uses only OWID's public endpoints.
defaultPrompt: Which Our World in Data chart shows global life expectancy over time?
Get the data behind Our World in Data's CO2 emissions per capita chart.
